n1e8b51087f.headline: ICICI Prudential receives  ₹3.67 crore tax order from GST authorities, stock down 10% YTD; Buy or sell? | Stock Market News
n1e8b51087f.summary: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance received a GST Commissioner order upholding a tax demand of about ₹3.67 crore. The insurer's stock has fallen nearly 10% year to date.
n1e8b51087f.why: ICICI Prudential Life is a major Indian life insurer, and tax disputes can affect its reported profitability.

n314113135e.headline: Germany’s PV installations down sharply in March
n314113135e.summary: Germany installed just 787.2 MW of new PV capacity in March. That is the lowest monthly total since December 2022.
n314113135e.why: Germany is Europe's largest solar market, so its installation pace affects module demand and the country's renewables targets.

naf716ad1e5.headline: People are melting their old jewelry for cash as gold prices soar
naf716ad1e5.summary: Jewellers are seeing customers eager to melt family heirlooms and other pieces as gold prices spike. The trend reflects the rising value of the metal.
naf716ad1e5.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a key safe-haven asset, and its price moves affect jewellers, miners and central bank reserves.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Rising prices encourage consumers to sell gold jewellery, reflecting the higher value of the metal.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n6b717cc31f.headline: UK PM Starmer discussed trade with Trump, Downing Street says
n6b717cc31f.summary: Downing Street says Starmer discussed trade with Trump after the US imposed 10% tariffs on most British goods and 25% on cars, steel and aluminium. Britain hopes to strike a deal.
n6b717cc31f.why: US tariffs on UK exports affect British manufacturers, sterling sentiment and the outlook for trade-exposed UK sectors such as autos and steel.

n3efa427999.headline: Young Nigerians are spending 2-3x more on data; they’re not happy about it
n3efa427999.summary: Young Nigerians are spending two to three times more on mobile data than just months ago, as data prices rise sharply, according to TechCabal.
n3efa427999.why: Mobile data pricing reflects telecom operators' revenues and affects household spending and digital-economy demand in Africa's largest economy.

n7712c68dd1.headline: Tidjane Thiam: Ex-Credit Suisse boss to run for Ivory Coast president
n7712c68dd1.summary: Former Credit Suisse chief executive Tidjane Thiam has been named as the candidate for Ivory Coast's main opposition party in the presidential race.
n7712c68dd1.why: Ivory Coast is a major West African economy and cocoa producer, so its political direction matters for commodity supply and investor sentiment in the region.

n0dcfd590bb.headline: NNPCL: Ojulari Sets $30bn Investment Target By 2027
n0dcfd590bb.summary: NNPC Ltd group chief executive Bashir Bayo Ojulari has set a target to attract $30 billion of investment by 2027. The article gives no further breakdown.
n0dcfd590bb.why: NNPC Ltd is Nigeria's state-owned oil company, and its investment plans shape upstream oil and gas activity in Nigeria.

n0585deb884.headline: Luxury fashion house Valentino reports a 22% drop in profits in 2024
n0585deb884.summary: Italian luxury house Valentino reported a 22% drop in operating profit for last year. The company cited slowing demand for high-end products, particularly in Asia.
n0585deb884.why: Valentino is a Rome-based luxury fashion house, and its results are a read-through for the broader luxury goods sector, which is sensitive to global consumer spending.

n1138b79a15.headline: Bursa Malaysia up 1.09%, a whisker away from key 1,500 level
n1138b79a15.summary: Bursa Malaysia closed up 1.09% on the final trading day of the week, finishing just short of the 1,500 level. Positive regional cues and improved sentiment supported the gain.
n1138b79a15.why: Bursa Malaysia is the Kuala Lumpur stock exchange, and its benchmark FBM KLCI tracks the largest companies listed in Malaysia.

n4da33bd2c2.headline: Sui Northern Gas Company asks OGRA to increase Rs735 per MMBTU in gas prices
n4da33bd2c2.summary: Sui Northern Gas Company submitted a request to the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority seeking an increase of Rs735 per MMBTU in gas prices. The request was filed on Friday.
n4da33bd2c2.why: Pakistan's gas tariffs are set by the regulator, and changes affect the cost base of gas utilities, industrial users and household energy bills.

n74bf87472f.headline: A tariff headache for major central banks
n74bf87472f.summary: US President Donald Trump's tariffs have darkened the global economic backdrop, forcing big central banks to reassess their next steps. The report was published by RTE.ie.
n74bf87472f.why: Central banks set interest rates, and trade tariffs affect growth and inflation, shaping rate expectations across bond and currency markets.

n500b3df24f.headline: Venice expands day-tripper tax in bid to combat overtourism
n500b3df24f.summary: Venice has started charging day-trippers an arrivals tax for the second year. The measure is aimed at combating overtourism that put the city's UNESCO World Heritage status at risk.
n500b3df24f.why: Tourism taxes affect visitor spending and municipal revenues in destination cities. Policy on overtourism can influence hospitality and travel sector demand.

n1ddd7666d0.headline: GST on UPI transactions over  ₹2,000? Here's what you need to know | Mint
n1ddd7666d0.summary: India's finance ministry called reports of GST on UPI payments above ₹2,000 completely false, misleading and without any basis. The ministry strongly denied the claims.
n1ddd7666d0.why: UPI is India's dominant digital payment system, so any tax change on transactions would affect consumers, fintech firms and digital payment volumes.

nd9a9fc26cb.headline: Rising insurance premiums: advocates say industry needs more oversight
nd9a9fc26cb.summary: A KPMG annual review found insurance profits soared in 2024 as consumers faced steep premium hikes. Experts say insurers could do more to keep coverage affordable for Australians.
nd9a9fc26cb.why: Insurance is a large financial sector in Australia, and premium levels and profitability affect insurers' earnings and household costs.

n6ee017d673.headline: 'Ghanaians can raise capital for mining,' says Minerals Commission Dep CEO after Damang takeover
n6ee017d673.summary: Ghana's Minerals Commission Deputy CEO says Ghanaian-owned companies now have the financial muscle and technical expertise to run large-scale mining operations. The remarks follow the Damang takeover.
n6ee017d673.why: Gold mining is a major source of export earnings for Ghana, and ownership changes at producing mines can affect output, investment and government revenue.

na4373f5d38.headline: Deadliest US strike in Yemen kills 74 at oil terminal
na4373f5d38.summary: The US military said strikes on Yemen's Ras Isa fuel terminal were aimed at cutting off a source of fuel. The strikes reportedly killed 74 people.
na4373f5d38.why: Ras Isa is a fuel export terminal on the Red Sea, and attacks on energy infrastructure in the region can affect oil flows and shipping risk.

n0e205526fd.headline: 'Gold Fields Ghana took profits to Chile and Canada' - Deputy Minerals Commission boss
n0e205526fd.summary: Ghana's Deputy Minerals Commission chief assessed Gold Fields' exit from the Damang mine and accused the South African miner of taking profits from Ghana to Chile and Canada.
n0e205526fd.why: Gold Fields is a large gold miner, and disputes over mine exits and profit repatriation affect investor views on African mining jurisdictions.

ne8941152b6.headline: Your jobs are safe – Lands Minister assures Damang Mines workers
ne8941152b6.summary: Ghana's Lands Minister said jobs at the Damang Mines are safe following the botched licence renewal of the Abosso Gold Fields operation.
ne8941152b6.why: Damang is a Ghanaian gold mine operated by Abosso Gold Fields, and licence issues affect output and investor confidence in Ghana's mining sector.

na98f979910.headline: Jonathan An-Dior-son
na98f979910.summary: Jonathan Anderson is heading to Dior after a decade reshaping LOEWE, in a move that Highsnobiety suggests the luxury label needs more than the designer needs Dior.
na98f979910.why: Dior is a flagship brand of LVMH, the world's largest luxury goods group, and creative leadership is central to luxury brand performance.

n9dc0389ca2.headline: Watch These AMD Price Levels as Stock Slides Amid New U.S. Rules on Chip Exports to China
n9dc0389ca2.summary: AMD shares fell after the U.S. imposed new licensing requirements on some AI chip exports to China. The chipmaker had joined a sector-wide sell-off the previous day.
n9dc0389ca2.why: Advanced Micro Devices designs CPUs and GPUs for data centers, PCs and gaming, and its China revenue is sensitive to US export controls.

impacts.name: Advanced Micro Devices
impacts.why: Shares fell after new US licensing requirements on some AI chip exports to China were announced.

n9dc0389ca2.why_moved: Shares fell after the U.S. imposed new licensing requirements on some AI chip exports to China, triggering a sector-wide sell-off.

n5b7d4f9e8a.headline: New Music Friday: Post Malone & Morgan Wallen, Ed Sheeran and more
n5b7d4f9e8a.summary: The Philippine peso rallied against the UAE dirham. A stronger local currency could mean lower remittances from Overseas Filipino Workers.
n5b7d4f9e8a.why: The peso-dirham rate determines how much Filipino workers in the UAE send home, which affects remittance flows to the Philippines.

nab73cfeb99.headline: Gold prices in Saudi Arabia moves up today – 18 April 2025
nab73cfeb99.summary: The price of 24-karat gold per tola in Saudi Arabia extended gains on Friday, April 18, to reach an all-time high of 4,672 SAR. The report is a local retail price update.
nab73cfeb99.why: Gold is a traditional store of value that investors use as a hedge against inflation and currency risk. Local retail prices track the international gold price adjusted for currency.

nce751ae446.headline: Pakistan accepts IMF's condition to prioritize climate change in development projects
nce751ae446.summary: Pakistan has agreed to an IMF condition to give more weight to climate change when selecting development projects, with climate factors making up 30% of criteria by August 2026.
nce751ae446.why: The IMF provides financing and conditions on Pakistan's policy, so its reforms shape public investment priorities and fiscal planning.

n44dc0ecc2f.headline: Even Easter Bunny cannot hide from high cost of living
n44dc0ecc2f.summary: Australians face high chocolate costs this Easter despite falling global cocoa prices. Some retail prices have not followed the decline in the raw commodity.
n44dc0ecc2f.why: Cocoa is a soft commodity grown mainly in West Africa, and its prices feed into confectionery manufacturing costs. Retail pass-through lags raw-material moves.

nb2a956fb66.headline: Labor vows to protect penalty rates if re-elected
nb2a956fb66.summary: The Labor government said it would enshrine penalty rates in law if re-elected. The measure would affect around three million Australian workers.
nb2a956fb66.why: Penalty rates set extra pay for work at unsocial hours and affect wage costs for retail, hospitality and other labour-intensive sectors.

nae2ad055dc.headline: Trump and Powell on Collision Course Without Easy Escape; ECB Cuts Rates to Counter Tariff Threat
nae2ad055dc.summary: President Trump is threatening to fire Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell, according to the report. The European Central Bank has cut interest rates to counter the tariff threat.
nae2ad055dc.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates and influences the dollar and Treasury yields. The ECB sets euro-area monetary policy, which affects European bonds and the euro.
nae2ad055dc.why_moved: The report points to a possible conflict between the US president and the Fed chair, and to an ECB rate cut made in response to tariff threats. Both raise uncertainty about policy direction.

n68df594cfb.headline: New US ambassador to Japan says he is optimistic two sides will reach deal over tariffs
n68df594cfb.summary: New US Ambassador to Japan George Glass said he is optimistic the two sides will reach a deal over tariffs upon arriving in Tokyo. Negotiations are ongoing.
n68df594cfb.why: Tariff agreements between the US and Japan affect trade in autos, electronics and other goods, and the companies that export between the two countries.

n7bfb951fc6.headline: New port fees on Chinese ships
n7bfb951fc6.summary: The United States is planning to impose new port fees on Chinese ships. No further details were given in the report.
n7bfb951fc6.why: Port fees raise the cost of shipping for vessels calling at US ports, which can feed into trade costs and freight rates.

n812fa2fc23.headline: Gold prices on a record-hitting spree: Can MCX Gold hit the  ₹1 lakh mark in April or May 2025? | Stock Market News
n812fa2fc23.summary: Gold prices have reached record highs in both domestic and international markets. The rally is attributed to economic uncertainty and geopolitical tensions, with the article assessing whether MCX gold could hit ₹1 lakh.
n812fa2fc23.why: Gold is a traditional store of value that investors often buy during economic and geopolitical stress. MCX is India's commodity exchange where domestic gold futures trade.

n9c4f717405.headline: Ringgit eases against greenback following slower GDP growth estimate
n9c4f717405.summary: The ringgit eased against the US dollar at the close after Malaysia's first-quarter 2025 GDP growth estimate came in lower than expected, according to an analyst.
n9c4f717405.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and GDP growth signals the health of Southeast Asia's third-largest economy. Weaker growth data often weighs on the currency and on local rates expectations.

n7e66a4434a.headline: Japan's core inflation accelerates, complicating BOJ's rate path
n7e66a4434a.summary: Japan's core inflation accelerated in March due to persistent rises in food costs, data showed on Friday. The data complicates the central bank's task of weighing price pressures against risks.
n7e66a4434a.why: The Bank of Japan sets the country's short-term interest rates and influences the yen and government bond yields. Inflation data is a key input into its policy decisions.

n07a3d9e5d4.headline: 'We’re not chasing out all mining companies' – Minerals Commission Dep boss defends Damang takeover
n07a3d9e5d4.summary: The Minerals Commission deputy chief rejected claims that Ghana is pursuing an aggressive anti-investor policy. The comments follow the government's decision to take over the Damang mine from Gold Fields Ghana.
n07a3d9e5d4.why: Gold Fields is a major listed gold miner, and government takeovers of mining assets affect investor confidence and future output in producing countries.

n88cf7cbd96.headline: Carney says lower internal trade barriers will help Canada more than Trump's tariffs will harm it
n88cf7cbd96.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney said eliminating trade barriers within Canada would benefit Canadians far more than Trump's trade war can take away. He made the case at the last debate before the April 28 vote.
n88cf7cbd96.why: Internal trade barriers between Canadian provinces raise costs for businesses, so reducing them is a key lever for offsetting tariff pressure on the economy.
